verdict.rationale: Unleash documents a few first-party capabilities that act on many items at once. These are export/import of feature flags for migration and change requests that group multiple changes and apply them together at a specific time. Reusable segments and release templates that apply across any number of flags are also documented. However, there is no explicit evidence of bulk edit, archive, toggle or delete actions across many flags, whether in the UI or through a bulk API endpoint. The Admin API's general programmatic access is only a building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented bulk actions (bulk enable/disable/archive/tag) across many flags, bulk API endpoints, AI/MCP-driven batch operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
